problems.title: Design a Parking Lot
problems.description: Design an automated multi-floor parking lot system supporting different vehicle types (Car, Bike, Truck). The system should handle spot allocation, entry/exit ticket generation, and parking fee calculation.

problems.title: Design an Elevator System
problems.description: Design an elevator control system managing multiple elevator cars across multiple floors. The system should efficiently dispatch elevator requests, control floor movement, handle direction state, and manage internal/external request queues.
